sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a place of worship
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property within Manhattan in the city of New York from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a building occupied exclusively as a school or place of worship.

sponsored.t: Relates to base pilotage tariffs at Sandy Hook, Sands Point and Execution Rocks
sponsored.sum: Relates to base pilotage tariffs rates at Sandy Hook, Sands Point and Execution Rocks for the years 2028 through 2032.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age for New York police department members
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age for New York police department members from 63 to 65.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability claims for a qualifying World Trade Center
sponsored.sum: Extends the deadline for filing disability claims for a qualifying World Trade Center condition until 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area; provides for a rebate program; provides for a process for application and certification.

sponsored.t: Permits structures to remain within a certain erosion hazard area or tidal wetland adjacent area
sponsored.sum: Permits structures to remain where the local permitting authority has issued a permit for construction built within a certain erosion hazard area or tidal wetland adjacent area.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of vape products that are made to be attractive to or target persons under the age of twenty-one
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of vape products that are made to be attractive to or target persons under the age of twenty-one or are sold in packaging that is made to be attractive to or target persons under the age of twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "CALM act" relating to commercial advertisement volume
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "CALM act" relating to prohibiting a person, firm, partnership, association or corporation providing a video streaming service that operates in the state of New York from transmitting the audio of commercial advertisements louder than the video content the advertisements accompany; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "consumer protection and automotive transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the consumer protection and automotive transparency act mandating transparency in automotive labeling relating to materials used in motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the investigation of moneys paid in connection with agreements for funeral merchandise or services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the bureau of funeral directing, under the direction of the commissioner of health to investigate claims brought against any person, firm or corporation relating to moneys paid in connection with agreements for funeral merchandise or services; provides that the bureau of funeral directing has the legal authority to investigate and, after due process, levy fines and sanctions on any unlicensed individuals and/or unregistered entities that are falsely acting as or representing themselves to be licensed and/or registered funeral directors and/or funeral firms in violation of the public health law.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state agency hotlines from relying exclusively on automated answering systems
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state agency hotlines from relying exclusively on automated answering systems; requires state agency hotlines to provide callers with a clear option to speak with a live representative.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting requirements for state call centers
sponsored.sum: Requires any state agency operating a state call center to annually publish on its public-facing website certain metrics relating to such state call center.

sponsored.t: Amends chapter 306 of the laws of 2011 authorizing owners of residential real property in high risk brush fire areas in the borough of Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property
sponsored.sum: Amends chapter 306 of the laws of 2011 authorizing owners of residential real property in high risk brush fire areas in the borough of Staten Island to cut and remove reeds from their property; extends through December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
sponsored.sum: Extends, until December 31, 2027, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the Silver Lake Foundation Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of Richmond county to grant the Silver Lake Foundation Inc. retroactive real property tax exempt status upon an application therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to assault in the second degree of an operator or crew of a passenger commuter ferry
sponsored.sum: Includes with intent to cause physical injury to an operator or crew of a passenger commuter ferry within assault in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "tenant repair reconciliation act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "tenant repair reconciliation act"; requires landlords of certain multiple dwellings to repair certain conditions within thirty days of notice of such conditions; allows a tenant to repair such conditions and seek repayment of expenses incurred, or to deduct such expenses from future rent; directs the NYC comptroller to collect fines for violations and distribute such funds for citywide preservation and upgrades of certain multiple dwellings.

sponsored.t: Exempts Staten Island residents from Verrazzano-Narrows bridge tolls
sponsored.sum: Exempts Staten Island residents from Verrazzano-Narrows bridge tolls; directs the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to create applications for such exemptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to alternative investment bonds
sponsored.sum: Relates to alternative finance investment bonds.

sponsored.t: Relates to use of revenues from tolls collected on the Verrazzano-Narrows bridge
sponsored.sum: Directs revenues from tolls collected on the Verrazzano-Narrows bridge to be applied to expansion of bus rapid transit and high-occupancy vehicle lanes in the borough of Staten Island.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain promotions to lieutenant or sergeant in the detective bureau in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain promotions to lieutenant or sergeant in the detective bureau in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Exempts residents of lower Manhattan and Staten Island from congestion surcharge pricing
sponsored.sum: Exempts residents of lower Manhattan and Staten Island from the congestion surcharge imposed under the tax law.

sponsored.t: Designates September eleventh as a public holiday
sponsored.sum: Designates September eleventh as a public holiday, known as 9/11 Remembrance day.

sponsored.t: Requires coverage for colorectal cancer early detection beginning at age thirty-five
sponsored.sum: Requires coverage for colorectal cancer early detection beginning at age thirty-five; adds coverage for colorectal cancer early detection as a required coverage for individual policies; requires notification of colorectal early detection coverage to be provided to insured individuals beginning at age thirty-five.

sponsored.t: Requires certain public schools to provide Halal food during lunch
sponsored.sum: Requires certain public schools in any city with a population over one million to offer Halal food options during lunch to students with dietary restrictions free of charge.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to engage in a good faith cooperative dialogue with employees who request accommodation due to a religious practice or observance
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to engage in a good faith cooperative dialogue with employees who request accommodation due to a religious practice or observance.

sponsored.t: Enacts the cannabis oversight and official engagement act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "cannabis oversight and official engagement act"; requires the office of cannabis management to notify appropriate elected officials of applications for adult-use retail dispensaries in their legislative districts; requires the office to consider any responses from such elected officials in determining an application for an adult-use retail dispensary license; requires such communications to be made public.

sponsored.t: Requires that transportation network companies provide TNC drivers with certain notices upon deactivation or suspension
sponsored.sum: Requires that transportation network companies provide TNC drivers with notices upon deactivation or suspension, explaining the cause of such deactivation or suspension and the steps by which such driver may remedy such deactivation or suspension.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for Gold Star children
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for Gold Star children in the amount of $1,500.

sponsored.t: Relates to cannabinoid hemp retail sales and retailers
sponsored.sum: Relates to cannabinoid hemp retail sales and retailers; makes technical changes to the definition of THC; provides specific requirements for labeling of cannabinoid hemp products.

sponsored.t: Relates to photo speed violation monitoring systems in school speed zones in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Reduces the radial distance from school buildings for such school speed zones.

sponsored.t: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders
sponsored.sum: Relates to the registration and regulation of animal breeders; requires each to be licensed; creates a breeder licensing fund; exempts not-for-profit organizations.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of judges in certain courts
sponsored.sum: Adds three additional family court judges to the county of Richmond; adds three additional judges to the civil court of the county of Richmond.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York State Muslim American Advisory Council
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York State Muslim American Advisory Council.

sponsored.t: Relates to business protection for point-of-sale equipment leases
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions relating to the lease of credit card terminals; requires disclosures; prohibits certain practices.

sponsored.t: Provides line of duty sick leave for first responders who are diagnosed with or display symptoms of a pandemic virus
sponsored.sum: Provides line of duty sick leave for first responders who are diagnosed with or display symptoms of a pandemic virus.

sponsored.t: Permits students of SUNY, CUNY, or state-funded institutions of higher education to observe certain holidays without facing academic repercussions
sponsored.sum: Permits students of SUNY, CUNY, or state-funded institutions of higher education to observe certain holidays without facing academic repercussions, provided they submit written notice of their intention to observe such holidays.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the New York wine & distilled spirits development act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "New York wine & distilled spirits development act"; allows individuals to hold more than one seven day license to sell liquor at retail for off-premises consumption; establishes the New York distilled spirits and wine industry marketing and promotion fund.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of economic development to conduct a study regarding increasing public access to museums in New York city
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of economic development, in conjunction with various departments and offices, to conduct a study regarding increasing public access to museums in New York city; directs a report on such study to be submitted no later than one year after the effective date.

sponsored.t: Requires health care professionals to prescribe opioid antagonists when prescribing an opioid
sponsored.sum: Requires health care professionals to prescribe opioid antagonists when prescribing an opioid and discuss the dangers of opioid addiction with such patient in a manner consistent with regulations promulgated by the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Relates to packaging and taxing of e-liquid products
sponsored.sum: Relates to verification of compliance with federal and state regulations on packaging of e-liquid products; relates to creating a "tobacco and vaping cessation fund" to be funded with tax revenue from sales of e-liquid products.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a parking permit system for park-and-rides in the borough of Staten Island in the city of New York; requires residents of Staten Island to receive a permit free of charge and out-of-state residents to pay an annual fee for such permit.

sponsored.t: Requires New York city identity cards to be accepted as valid written evidence of age or identification
sponsored.sum: Requires New York city identity cards to be accepted as valid written evidence of age or identification.

sponsored.t: Imposes increased fines on certain individuals who commit riot in the first degree during a state disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Imposes increased fines on certain individuals who commit riot in the first degree during a state disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale, manufacture, and distribution of vapor products
sponsored.sum: Relates to the sale, manufacture, and distribution of vapor products; requires distributors and manufacturers of vapor products to obtain permits; prohibits the sale of illicit vapor products; creates a vapor product directory.

sponsored.t: Relates to rights of car wash facility customers to file a complaint regarding damages sustained from such car wash facility
sponsored.sum: Requires certain car wash facilities to display a notice to customers that such customers may file a complaint regarding damages sustained from such car wash facility to the consumer protection division.

sponsored.t: Allows school principals in the city of New York to hire coaches who are not also teachers
sponsored.sum: Allows school principals in the city of New York to hire coaches who are not also teachers, provided that such coaches meet the qualifications set forth by relevant athletic organizations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of cannabinoid hemp products
sponsored.sum: Provides that a retailer licensed by the office of cannabis management shall be permitted to sell any and all forms of cannabinoid hemp.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city housing authority to address certain repairs within thirty days after receipt of a written notice to management
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city housing authority to repair certain conditions within thirty days of receipt of a written notice requesting such repairs; requires NYCHA to convert from gas to electric appliances when repairing or replacing any such appliances.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the effects of the congestion surcharge imposed in lower Manhattan
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the effects of the congestion surcharge imposed in lower Manhattan, including impacts to residents and businesses in the congestion zone, and any reduction in emissions resulting from such surcharge; requires a report on the findings of such study to be submitted no later than 2 years after the effective date.

sponsored.t: Relates to employees covered under certain provisions relating to laborers, workers or mechanics
sponsored.sum: Requires employees of a public passenger ferry system employed as United States coast guard-licensed officers or in any position for which a United States coast guard officer license, endorsement or credential is required by law or by the relevant civil service job specifications, to be included under the phrase "laborers, workers or mechanics" as used under certain provisions of the labor law relating to the ability of employee organizations to negotiate with employers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of flashing signals to indicate the presence of a photo speed violation monitoring system
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of flashing signals to indicate the presence of a photo speed violation monitoring system that is located in a residential area; directs the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles to define the meaning of "residential area" for such purposes.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination of students on school property or at a school function based on religious attire, clothing or facial hair
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination of students on school property or at a school function based on religious attire, clothing or facial hair.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a certain property operating as a private membership establishment to sell alcohol for on-premises consumption to members and their guests
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a certain property operating as a private membership establishment to sell alcohol for on-premises consumption to members and their guests; defines "private membership establishment"; provides that such provisions shall not be interpreted to authorize any form of discrimination.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service to $50,000
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service in the year 2026 and thereafter to $50,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a respiratory therapy demonstration program for residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a respiratory therapy demonstration program for residential health care facilities; authorizes the commissioner of health approve up to ten residential health care facilities within the state to operate respiratory therapy units.

sponsored.t: Provides that a default judgment against a defendant in a foreclosure action does not need to be vacated for such defendant to claim the plaintiff lacks standing or that the statute of limitations has expired
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that a default judgment against a defendant in a foreclosure action does not need to be vacated in order for the defense of lack of standing or expiration of the statute of limitations to be raised by the defendant.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for food service establishment donations to food pantries
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for food service establishment donations to food pantries, in the amount of fifty percent of the marketed value of each of the taxpayer's qualified donations up to six dollars per qualified donation, beginning with the 2027 tax year.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
sponsored.sum: Extends, until December 31, 2026, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds.

sponsored.t: Extends the moratorium on the issuance of environmental safety certificates for facilities and routes for the transportation of liquefied natural or petroleum gas
sponsored.sum: Extends the moratorium on the issuance of certificates of environmental safety for the siting of facilities and certification of routes for the transportation of liquefied natural or petroleum gas.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of members of the Battery Park city authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to the appointment of members of the Battery Park city authority; increases the number of members to nine; requires five of the nine members be primary residents of Battery Park city.

sponsored.t: Relates to false representation of affiliation or approval of state or local agencies as false advertising
sponsored.sum: Provides that a false representation of affiliation or approval, or false implication of such affiliation or approval, of any official, state or local agencies or other official source, shall be false advertising.

sponsored.t: Includes information on congenital heart defect births as part of the department of health's health care and wellness education and outreach program; repealer
sponsored.sum: Includes information on congenital heart defect births as part of the department of health's health care and wellness education and outreach program; amends the effectiveness thereof.
